item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 02/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring rainy weather to the region. With the upper-air disturbance departing and easterly airstream moderating, the weather will be brighter with temperatures rising over the coast of southern China early next week. It will be misty in the morning and at night. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
